text: Coffee with Georgia. Her dad had a fall on the stairs last week and broke his wrist, so she's been driving to Leeds every weekend. She sounded wiped out, and her son Jack has his Grade 5 piano exam on November 12th on top of everything. Her husband's away with work till the 20th too. Remind me to call her Sunday, and maybe offer to take Jack to the exam.
Chris and Eilidh have finally found a flat in Glasgow, two bed in Dennistoun. Moving date is November 14th. They're doing a housewarming sometime in December once the boxes are gone.
Nikhil's daughter starts reception on September 3rd. He's way more nervous than she is apparently. Her name is Priya, she's obsessed with dinosaurs.

Caught up with Gustavo after five a side. His mum's in hospital with pneumonia, been there since Tuesday. His sister Ilse flew in from Rotterdam to help. Gustavo's been sleeping on a chair in the ward most nights. Their dad died a few years back so it's just the two of them. Should text him tomorrow to see how she's doing, and offer to cover his shift on Saturday.
Chidi graduates from Edinburgh on 2 July 2027, law. His parents are flying over from Lagos for it. I've said I'll go to the drinks after.
Ryan's moving to Manchester in March 2027 for the new job. Viewing three places on 2/8. Wife's not thrilled about leaving Bristol.
Bruno sprained his ankle at climbing, out for six weeks minimum. Gutted because he had the Ben Nevis trip on May 14. Don't forget to drop off the crutches I've got in the loft.

Long call with Patrick. Kids are all over the place: Ciara has her GCSE results on August 21st, the little one's starting secondary in September, and their dog Biscuit just had surgery on his leg. He's coping, just about. Wants to do a pub night once results are out.
Reza mentioned his wife Nora is pregnant again, due June 3rd. They're thinking about moving somewhere with a garden before then, maybe Harrogate.
Tobi (TJ) got into Cambridge for his masters!! Starts October 2027. Jess is beside herself with pride, she kept showing everyone the email.
Isla's little boy has had chickenpox all week so she's been off work. Her partner Owen is on nights so it's all on her. Need to drop round some soup and the Lego I promised.

Anya viewing flats in Lisbon on 3/12 and 3/14. If one works out she moves in April. Says the rents are mad now but still cheaper than London. Her boss has agreed she can work remotely as long as she comes back once a month. Her flatmate Ioana is taking over the lease here. Anya's also trying to rehome her rabbit Clover before she goes.
Femi had his knee op on Friday. Recovery's slow, he's stuck on the sofa watching darts. Ring him later this week.

Bumped into Yara at the school gates. Her eldest, Leila, did her first day at big school yesterday and came home in tears, but she said today was better. Yara herself is doing an OU course in psychology, exams in June.
Mandla's dad was diagnosed with type 2 diabetes. Mandla is trying to get him to cut down on sugar, without much luck. His brother Sipho is useless apparently.
Afua and Kieran are moving in together on 1 December 2026. They've got a place in Walthamstow near the market. Kieran's doing the van, I'm helping carry stuff.
Pedro's graduation ceremony is May 22nd at Warwick. His mum's coming over from Porto. Must sort a card and maybe a bottle of port as a joke.
Seo-yeon is moving back to Seoul in January. Her mum's not been well and she wants to be closer. Leaving do is probably mid December. Ask her about dates.
Yosef's son broke his arm falling off the trampoline Sunday. Cast for five weeks. Kid is loving all the attention, Yosef less so.
Ioana passed her driving test on the third attempt! Her boyfriend Finn bought her a keyring shaped like a tiny Dacia. Should congratulate her properly.
Helen's retiring in March 2027 after 30 years at the council. Party will be at the Crown, date TBC. She's dropping hints about wanting a decent pair of walking boots.

Reggie's mum had a stroke on October 9th. She's stable now but can't speak much yet. He's taken two weeks off. His wife Mandy is handling the kids, and his sister is flying back from Toronto on the 22nd. Physio starts next week and the doctors say the next three months matter most. Text Reggie tonight, nothing heavy, just letting him know I'm thinking of him.
Xavier's twins sit their 11+ on 9/14. He's been tutoring them every evening and is properly stressed. Both want to get into the grammar.
Sorted the boiler service for 11/3. Need to clear the cupboard before then.
Flat viewing at 10 tomorrow, the one on Harbour Street. Bring the checklist and measure the bedroom.

Chat with Georgia and her husband Chris. They're selling up and moving to Cornwall in the spring, house is on the market from next week. Georgia's a bit sad about leaving the kids' school but Chris is buzzing. Their cat Pickle hates the car so the drive down will be fun.
Nikhil Gupta has had a nasty chest infection for two weeks and is still coughing. He's missed the conference in Berlin because of it. Check in with him on Friday.
Eilidh's brother Callum graduates from St Andrews on June 26th. Whole family going, she's booked a cottage for the weekend. She'll be away 6/25 to 6/28.
Lunch with Gustavo Garcia. He's training for the Valencia marathon on 6 December 2026, wants sub 3:30. Also building his own bike. Big Arsenal fan, don't mention Spurs.
Chidi's daughter Adaeze took her first steps at the weekend! He sent a video. Adorable.

Ilse's moving out of the houseshare at the end of the month. She's been offered a job in Copenhagen starting November 17th. Bit nervous about the language. Should take her out for a farewell dinner before she goes.
Ryan said his son Alfie has been off school with a bad ear infection, third one this year. They've got an ENT appointment on 12/2 about grommets. He's worried.
The house move to Bath is off, buyers pulled out. Bruno's gutted but says they'll relist in the new year.

Patrick Murphy and his wife are celebrating their daughter's graduation from nursing on July 10th with a big family barbecue. Their son Declan also starts uni in Galway in September. He's dead nervous about living away from home.
Reza's mum is back in hospital, kidney stuff again. He's going up to Newcastle this weekend and next. Don't forget to ask how the scan went on Monday.
Nora's little one, Darius, started nursery today. Two hours in and she was already checking the app. Said she'd tell me how the first week goes.
Tobi wants to move to Berlin next year, maybe September 2027. Learning German on Duolingo, 200 day streak. Also mad into vinyl, mostly jazz.
Jess's dad is having a hip replacement on November 5th. She's taking a week off to look after him. Her sister Abi lives too far to help. I should send flowers to the house that weekend.
Haircut moved to Thursday. Pick up dry cleaning on the way.

Isla and Owen are doing a viewing in Leith on Saturday, a three bed with a garden. They want to be in before their daughter starts primary next August. Owen thinks it's overpriced. Isla's already picked out the paint colours apparently.
Anya Williams finished her PhD viva yesterday, passed with minor corrections! Graduation is 15 January 2027. She wants to celebrate with dinner at that Ethiopian place.
Femi's son Tunde got his A level results: A*AA, he's off to Imperial for engineering. Femi was nearly in tears telling me. Remind me to get Tunde a card and some cash.
Yara had a migraine all weekend, missed her niece's christening on Sunday. Feeling better now but annoyed.

Mandla and his partner Afua are expecting their first in March 2027. They've just moved into a bigger place in Croydon to make room. Mandla says Afua's had awful morning sickness and has barely been able to work since August. Her mum is coming over from Accra in February to help out. Ask Mandla how the 20 week scan goes on 11/19.
Owen told me his gran passed away on Thursday. Funeral's in Cork on 10/30. He's flying over the day before. Need to message him before he goes.
Pedro's moving flats again, third time this year. New place is in Hackney, above a bakery. Keys on October 28th.
Seo-yeon's son Min-jun did his first piano recital last night. Played Für Elise with only one wobble. She said he'd been practising for months.

Talked to Yosef about his move to Tel Aviv. His wife got a hospital job there starting April 1st and they're shipping everything at the end of February. Their two kids are anxious about changing schools mid year. He's trying to sell the car before February 14th. Help him list it this week.

Ioana's mum has been in and out of hospital in Cluj since the summer, heart problems. Ioana flies out on December 18th and stays through New Year. She's really struggling with being so far away. Must keep checking in with her.
Helen's grandson Archie starts school on 9/4. She bought him a tiny backpack with a fox on it.
Reggie's daughter graduated from Leeds on July 18th, first in the family to go to uni. He's so proud. Missed sending something at the time, I should send a belated card now.
Kieran's back is still bad after the gym injury. Physio twice a week. He's trying swimming instead. Also thinking of moving closer to work, maybe Clapham.

Finn and his girlfriend Ioana are flat hunting in Bristol. Viewings on 4/3 and 4/5, moving by May. Finn's starting a new teaching job there after Easter. They're keeping the cat, a grumpy tabby called Pudding.

Xavier's mum was diagnosed with early dementia last month. He's going to look at care homes with his brother Luc on November 8th and again on the 15th. He's not sleeping well. I'm going round Thursday with a curry. Should ask him about the visits after.
Georgia mentioned Nikhil and his wife have moved to Birmingham already. Didn't even know. Get his new address.
Just booked my own flights home for Christmas, Dec 20th to Jan 3rd. Mum wants me to bring the dog.
Chris Hughes broke two ribs playing rugby on Saturday. Says it hurts to laugh. He was supposed to be best man at his cousin's wedding on 11/22, still hoping to make it.

Eilidh's sister had her baby on October 15th, a girl called Mairi. Eilidh's flying up on the 25th to meet her and stay a week. She's going to be such a fun auntie. Little gift for the baby would be nice.

Gustavo's daughter Lucia finishes her GCSE mocks on 12/12 and he says she's been a ball of stress. Tutoring Saturdays. Real exams are May 2027. She wants to do medicine so the pressure's on, and her mum Carla keeps reminding her. Lucia's also captain of the netball team, they've got the county final on 12/6. Text her dad that week to see how they went.
Afua Mensah's school reunion is March 2027, she's organising. Also she's started pottery on Tuesdays and is surprisingly good. Brought me a lopsided mug.
